cohort: The study included 110 patients who underwent cesarean section with a diagnosis of placenta previa or low-lying placenta previa, excluding those with multiple pregnancies or incomplete early pregnancy uterine images.
finding: Patients with placenta previa and low-lying placenta previa who had endometriosis were significantly more likely to have a retroverted uterus and a retroverted uterus with a posterior placenta compared to those without endometriosis.
